thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT fired: 5xx_gateway_spike (service: inference-gateway) — 3m rolling error-rate = 1.8% > threshold 0.5%

Maya: I got paged. seeing customer-facing 502/504s from the gateway, looks like spikes started ~1799990060. tagging oncall.

Raj: jumping in. any obvious deploys in last 10m?

Olivia: no full deploys from CI. deploy-bot shows only a config push at 1799989000 (no rollout). I can see increased latency to upstream provider X in traces — a bunch of 502s from provider-edge.

Kevin: confirming — from edge traces: provider-x timeout -> gateway returns 502. traffic stayed same, so this seems upstream.

Maya: ok mitigation options: 1) activate fallback routing to provider-y for non-pss customers, 2) temporarily increase retry/backoff for provider-x calls, 3) enable caching for common prefixes. thoughts?

Raj: quick wins first: flip routing to provider-y for 20% of traffic (canary) + increase provider-x request timeout from 3s to 7s to avoid cascading 5xxs. I'll run the canary now.

SRE-Shift-Lead: FYI, customer-impact tag on incident: "high" until we confirm otherwise. Paging stays on.

Raj: canary config applied: routed 20% -> provider-y. rolling metrics: error-rate dropped to 0.6% in canary cohort. overall still 1.2%.

Olivia: provider-x still showing elevated 5xx responses at the edge. opening ticket with provider-x support (case #PX-4321). forwarding trace samples.

Tanvi: adding temporary circuit-breaker in gateway for provider-x at 3s latency, will return 503 fast instead of cascading timeouts. applying now.

Maya: good. also reducing default retry from 2 -> 1 for provider-x to avoid head-of-line effects.

Raj: applied circuit-breaker + retry change. overall 5xx is down to 0.3% now. latency tail improved.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigation applied by Raj, Tanvi, Maya — status: degraded -> recovering.

Kevin: sounds like mitigation worked. we should tune the alerting — this page fired on a 3m rolling >0.5% which made us page for a ~6m upstream blip. less noisy alerts would be: require sustained 5m or 2 consecutive 3m buckets + add upstream tag filtering.

Maya: Agreed. Proposal: change rule to `sum(5xx)/sum(requests) > 0.8%` over 5m OR alert on spike in provider-x errors specifically (high-cardinality tag), not global gateway 5xx. Also add a severity mapping: >1.5% = page, 0.8-1.5% = ticket.

Tanvi: sounds good. we should also add a dashboard panel with provider breakdown and a heatmap of 5xx by upstream -> that'll make mitigation faster next time.

Olivia: I'll create the Grafana dashboard and share the link. also writing a snippet for the runbook to check provider health and flip canary.

Maya: please also add runbook step to check traces for repeated trace-ids (indicates retry storms) and a quick playbook to toggle provider-x circuit breaker.

Raj: I'll open the alert-change PR: altering the Prometheus rule and adding annotations with runbook link. PR: https://git.internal/rules/changes/1799990123

Tanvi: quick note on thresholds — provider-x has more noisy transient errors historically. for provider-x only alerts, use 1% threshold, global gateway use 0.8% over 5m with count min 100 requests.

Maya: capture action items: 1) Raj -> PR to change alert rules (due EOD), 2) Olivia -> new Grafana panel + runbook updates (tomorrow AM), 3) Tanvi -> add circuit-breaker toggle to ops console (low effort UI) (3 days), 4) Kevin -> follow up with provider-x support (ongoing).

SRE-Shift-Lead: tagging for post-incident review (PIR). schedule 1-hour blameless review tomorrow 10:00. owners above.

Olivia: dashboard created draft: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/provider-5xx-breakdown — I'll move to team folder after feedback.

Raj: PR open: https://git.internal/rules/changes/1799990123 (includes new severity mapping, 5m window, min-count, and provider-specific rules). requesting reviews from @Maya and @Tanvi.

Maya: reviewing PR now. small nit on annotation text, otherwise LGTM.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: mitigation succeeded, error-rate stable below threshold for 20m. incident state -> resolved :white_check_mark:

Maya: closing here. postmortem owners: Raj (alerts), Olivia (dashboards/runbooks), Tanvi (ops UI). We'll assign timelines in the PIR. good job team.

Kevin: thanks everyone. noted we should communicate to customer-success if provider ticket requires client notices.

Olivia: I'll draft a short internal summary and paste in #customer-impact if needed.

Maya: thanks. ending thread. :tada:
